if: the document is a credit note or a debit note referred to in section 34
it is issued under rule 53(1A) of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: the credit or debit note MUST carry a consecutive serial number of at most sixteen characters, unique for the financial year
note: One mandatory particular of rule 53(1A)(c), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.
